data.body:
[P1] Detect sequence-write privileges before declaring PostgreSQL read-only

This filter excludes sequences, while the function check excludes built-ins in `pg_catalog`. A non-superuser with schema access and `UPDATE` on a sequence, but no table-write privileges or callable definer functions, therefore gets `read-only`. Yet `SELECT setval('public.order_ids', 1, false)` passes `assertReadOnly` and resets persistent sequence state, potentially causing duplicate application IDs. The MCP gate caches permission without prompting. Include sequence `USAGE`/`UPDATE` privileges in the risk check, or return `unknown` when those capabilities cannot be excluded.
